messages:
maria: Quick check — we need final RN copy + internal announcement timing for tomorrow's change window. Hard-stop window is 02:00-03:00 UTC. Can folks confirm messaging and rollback plan? @kevin @alice

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: inference-service v2.13.0-rc3 -> canary 10% in us-west-2 at 02:05 UTC. If rollback requested: /rollback v2.13.0-rc2. Monitor: deploy/logs and deploy/alerts.

kevin: I'll be on for the window (02:00-03:30). Plan smoke + latency checks at +5m and +20m. Abort if 95p > 300ms or error rate > 1%.

alice: Sounds good. Suggest the internal blurb call out: impact (possible brief 5xx spikes for a tiny %), caching rewarm, and pinning instructions for Dedicated customers.

product-liz: Draft blurb suggestion: 'We are rolling out performance improvements and a kernel selector update; some customers may see transient errors. No action required unless you see persistent errors >5% — we'll post updates.' Thoughts?

maria: I edited the blurb — see below.
```
Internal: Tomorrow 02:00-03:00 UTC we will deploy inference-service v2.13.0-rc3 (canary 10% -> ramp). Expect short-lived 5xx errors for a small fraction of traffic while caches rewarm. Rollback plan: pin to v2.13.0-rc2 via Console or runbook CLI. On-call: @kevin, @jen-ops. We will send the internal announcement only after canary +60m if stable.
```

jen-ops: Add to ops runbook: 'Hard-stop at 02:55 UTC — if steady-state latency not met by then, cut traffic back to rc2 and notify eng-releases.' I'll add the explicit steps and the console rollback link.

sam: Can we hold internal announcement until canary +60m? Want to avoid noisy comms if we have to rollback.

maria: Yes — plan: announce to company at 03:10 UTC only if canary stable. If rollback happens we'll send an 'aborted' note with root cause and mitigation. Also need RN link — @devex-bot where should we pin the release notes?

devex-bot: Release notes draft created: https://confluence.redwood/inference/rn/v2.13.0-rc3 — draft owner @sam. Please review and add QA callouts.

alice: I'm adding the 'version pin' snippet for Dedicated customers: `recommended_pin: v2.13.0-rc3` and rollback CLI example: `redwood deploy rollback --version v2.13.0-rc2`. Will paste into the RN.

maria: Thanks — final ask: any objections to the hard-stop at 02:55? If none, I'll schedule the internal blast template and pin the RN link to the release ticket.

kevin: :thumbsup:

product-liz: :shipit:

jen-ops: :white_check_mark: I'll update runbook + alert tags now.

maria: Great — I'll post the internal announcement draft in #announcements at T+70m if stable. If anyone wants to tweak the RN copy before I pin it, speak now or DM me.
